# maple_uptime_monitor (Resource)

An HTTP, TCP, DNS or heartbeat uptime monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "maple_uptime_monitor" "api" {
  name = "Public API"
  config = jsonencode({
    type   = "http"
    url    = "https://api.example.com/health"
    method = "GET"
    assertions = [
      { type = "status", op = "is", value = "2xx" },
      { type = "latency", under_ms = 1000 },
    ]
  })
  interval_seconds = 60
  failures_to_down = 2
  service_name     = "api"
  destination_ids  = [maple_alert_destination.pagerduty.id]
}

# A heartbeat: your job pings heartbeat_url, Maple alerts when it stops.
resource "maple_uptime_monitor" "nightly_backup" {
  name = "Nightly backup"
  config = jsonencode({
    type          = "heartbeat"
    schedule      = { type = "cron", expression = "0 3 * * *", timezone = "Europe/Berlin" }
    grace_seconds = 900
  })
  destination_ids = [maple_alert_destination.pagerduty.id]
}

output "backup_heartbeat_url" {
  value = maple_uptime_monitor.nightly_backup.heartbeat_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) The check, with `type` `http`, `tcp`, `dns` or `heartbeat`. Write it with `jsonencode(...)`. Changing `type` replaces the monitor.
- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `destination_ids` (List of String) `dest_…` IDs notified when the monitor goes down or recovers.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether checks run. Defaults to `true`.
- `failures_to_down` (Number) Failed checks in a row before the monitor is down, 1 to 10.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks, 30 to 3600.
- `service_name` (String) Attach the monitor to this service.

### Read-Only

- `alert_rule_id` (String) The alert rule that delivers this monitor's notifications.
- `heartbeat_url` (String) `heartbeat`: the URL your job pings.
- `id` (String) The `upm_…` public ID.
- `kind` (String) The monitor kind, from `config.type`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import maple_uptime_monitor.example <id>
```
